item.name: Badge of the Savant (Abjuration)
entries: A {@i badge of the savant} is a platinum bookplate that can be magically affixed to a wizard's spellbook. Each badge features a design that represents a different school of magic. While a badge is attached to the cover of your spellbook, the gold and time you must spend to copy a spell of that badge's school of magic into your spellbook is halved. You can collect multiple of these plates and fit them onto the cover of your spellbook, allowing you to gain this benefit for multiple schools of magic at once.
You can use an action to attach or remove a badge from a spellbook by expending a spell slot of a level equal to 1 plus the number of badges already on the book (a maximum of a 9th level spell slot).

item.name: Badge of the Savant
entries: A {@i badge of the savant} is a platinum bookplate that can be magically affixed to a wizard's spellbook. Each badge features a design that represents a different school of magic. While a badge is attached to the cover of your spellbook, the gold and time you must spend to copy a spell of that badge's school of magic into your spellbook is halved. You can collect multiple of these plates and fit them onto the cover of your spellbook, allowing you to gain this benefit for multiple schools of magic at once.
You can use an action to attach or remove a badge from a spellbook by expending a spell slot of a level equal to 1 plus the number of badges already on the book (a maximum of a 9th level spell slot).
Multiple variations of this item exist, as listed below:

item.name: Aurora Dust
entries: This bag is filled with {@dice 1d6 + 4} pinches of iridescent blue dust. You can use an action to sprinkle a pinch of it over an open flame. The dust changes the flame's color and light to a mixture of blue, green, and purple, and creates a shimmering aurora the same color above it within the bright light. The dust's effect lasts for the flame's duration (up to 24 hours).

item.name: Astronomer's Boon
entries: This brass astrolabe has a glass back that sparkles softly when light shines through it. While looking through the glass at the night sky, the names and patterns of any constellation you can see appear alongside their stars on the astrolabe. At the GM's discretion, you may find one or more of the following constellations while looking through the glass. When you do, the astrolabe begins to glow, and you can use an action to speak the item's command word to gain the constellation's respective benefit:

entries.name: The Drum
entries: 3 stars appear on your back in the shape of a drum. When you roll for initiative, you can expend 1 of the stars as a reaction to grant you and any other friendly creature within 10 feet of you a +1 bonus to the roll. In addition, any creature that gains this bonus to initiative can use a bonus action on its first turn of combat to take either the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action.

entries.name: The Knight
entries: 5 stars appear on your arm in the shape of a sword. When you hit with a melee attack, you can choose to expend 1 of the stars as part of the attack to cause the target to take an extra {@damage 1d4} radiant damage. Alternatively, if a friendly creature within 30 feet of you that you can see hits a target with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to expend 1 of the stars and empower the attack with light, causing the target to take an extra {@damage 1d4} radiant damage.

entries.name: The Seer
entries: 4 stars appear on your forehead in the shape of an eye. You can use a bonus action to expend 1 of the stars and touch a creature. Once within the next 10 minutes, that creature can choose to add {@dice 1d4} to an ability check or saving throw that it makes. It can choose to roll the die before or after making the ability check or saving throw.
The stars remain until the next dusk, at which point any unused stars vanish and are lost. Once the astrolabe has granted a benefit in this way, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Astral Caltrops
entries: As an action, you can spread these magic caltrops over a square area that is 5 feet on a side. Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage. When this happens, the caltrops explode in a burst of extraplanar energy, destroying the caltrops and dealing {@damage 6d6} force damage to the creature and causing it to rise vertically up to 20 feet, as if by the {@spell levitate} spell. The creature remains suspended in this way for {@dice 1d4} rounds, during which time its speed becomes 0. The effect ends early if the creature takes any damage.

When the caltrops are spread on the ground, they become nearly invisible and float up to 1 inch off the ground. A creature notices the caltrops with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. You can reclaim the invisible caltrops for later use with 1 minute of careful searching and collecting. The caltrops stop floating and become visible once they're reclaimed in this way.

item.name: Armor of Icarus
entries: This sculpted breastplate has a pair of small mechanical wings attached to its back. You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. The armor has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the armor, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to magically unfurl the mechanical wings and fly up to 60 feet in a straight line toward a point of bright light that you can see (such as a torch, light spell, or the sun) without provoking opportunity attacks. The wings remain unfurled until you touch the ground, during which time you fall at a rate of 30 feet per round and gain a flying speed of 30 feet, which you can use to glide horizontally as you descend. While gliding in this way, you cannot fly upwards unless you use the armor to fly toward a point of bright light again. When you land on the ground while falling in this way, the mechanical wings refold themselves to your back, and you take no damage from falling.

item.name: Archivist's Key
entries: This magical key is one of several made by a secret order of historians and archivists. While holding the key, you can use an action to twist the key, as if you were unlocking a door. When you do, a magical, spectral door slowly appears in front of you over the course of 1 minute, duplicating the effect of the {@spell Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion|PHB|magnificent mansion} spell with the following change. The dwelling always includes a large library that magically includes copies of books, scrolls, maps, and more. The library does not count toward the total amount of space created by the spell. Its contents are strangely organized and seemingly change each time the key is used. A creature can visit the library and attempt to uncover a piece of knowledge, such as ancient poetry, the history of a forgotten kingdom, or the family lineage of a tyrannical king. The GM determines the checks and DCs needed to locate a given piece of information. For example, a book of foreign nursery rhymes may be easy to find, but a copy of necromantic research documents would be extremely difficult, if not impossible.
When the spell ends, the key can't be used this way again for 24 hours.

item.name: Arcanist's Scribing Wand
entries: This wand's handle has a fountain pen nib at its end that releases its own magical ink. When you use this pen to copy a spell into your spellbook, the gold it takes to do so is halved. Swinging the wand causes tiny droplets of illusory ink to trail behind it.
The wand has 7 charges for the following properties:

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell comprehend languages|PHB} (written language only) or {@spell illusory script|PHB}.

entries.name: Cloudscript
entries: While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 2 of its charges to cause up to 10 words to appear in the sky. The words are formed from wisps of clouds or smoke (your choice) and remain in place as long as you concentrate (as if concentrating on a spell), to a maximum of 1 hour, or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses them.
The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the wand dissolves into a puddle of mundane ink and is destroyed.

item.name: Arcanist's Magnificent Magnifier
entries: This magical magnifying glass helps deduce the arcane nature of items. While looking through the glass at an object within 1 foot of you, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check you make regarding that object's magical properties. In addition, you can speak the glass's command word as an action to cast the {@spell identify|PHB} spell from it, targeting an object with the spell that you can see through the glass within 1 foot of you. Each time you do, there is a cumulative {@chance 5|5 percent} chance that the glass shatters and is destroyed after casting the spell.

item.name: Arcanist Gauntlets
entries: This pair of rich silk gloves is guarded by an enchanted mithral shell that sporadically releases arcane power. You can use the gauntlets as a spellcasting focus while wearing them, and when you cast a spell using a spell slot of 5th level or lower, you can choose to roll a {@dice d6}. If you roll a number on the d6 equal to or greater than the spell's slot level, the spell draws on the magic within the gauntlets, instead of your own, and is cast without expending a spell slot. The slot must be of a level you can normally cast. The gauntlets can provide up to 5 levels worth of spell slots in this way each day, and no two slots can be the same level.

If the number rolled on the {@dice d6} is less than the spell slot's level, you cast the spell as normal and expend the spell slot. If you don't have the spell slot to cast the spell, the spell fails and the slot is counted toward the gauntlets' daily provided spell slots.

For example, a 9th-level wizard can use the gauntlets to provide either one 5th-level spell slot or a 4th- and 1st-level spell slot over the course of a day, but not two 2nd- or 3rd-level spell slots.

item.name: Arc of the Alicorn
entries: This magic ivory bow is sculpted to look like a pair of curved unicorn horns and is strung with the finely braided hair of a pegasus' mane. This bow's damage die is a {@damage d10} instead of a {@damage d8}.
The bow has 4 charges for the following properties. It regains all expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Flight
entries: While holding the bow, you can use a bonus action to expend 1 of its charges to cause small wings to appear on your feet that last until the end of your turn. For the duration, you have a flying speed of 90 feet. While the wings remain, you can choose to expend another charge from the bow at the end of each of your turns (no action required) to extend the wings' duration until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Healing Horn
entries: While holding the bow, you can use a bonus action to expend 1 of its charges to fire a magical arrow of pure light at a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you, causing that creature to regain {@dice 2d6 + 2} hit points.

entries.name: Trampling Arrow
entries: When you make a ranged attack with the bow, you can expend 1 of its charges to cause the fired arrow to transform into a spectral, charging pegasus. On a hit, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d6} force damage and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target of the attack is already {@condition prone}, you ignore the normal disadvantage imposed on ranged attack rolls against {@condition prone} creatures and make the roll with advantage instead.

item.name: Arborguard Shield
entries: This massive wooden shield was made using the bark of an ancient treant. While holding it, you have a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.

While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as an action to create a wall of up to twelve trees on a solid surface within 120 feet of you. Each tree is 5 feet across at its base, up to 20 feet tall, and must be contiguous with another tree. Alternatively, you can create a ringed wall of trees up to 25 feet in diameter centered on your space. The trees grow tightly next to each other, preventing movement between them and providing total cover to anything behind them. A tree only grows a canopy if there is room for it.

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature within its area is pushed to one side of the wall and must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 8d6} bludgeoning or piercing damage (your choice), or half as much damage on a successful save.

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. Each tree has AC 13, 20 hit points, and is vulnerable to fire damage. A tree disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the effect ends.

While you're within 30 feet of the wall, you can see through a tree's space (no action required) using your senses. When you make a melee weapon attack while within 30 feet of one or more of the trees, you can make the attack as if you were in one of the trees' spaces. When you do, the tree magically forms a wooden copy of you and any weapon you're holding to make the attack: duplicating any of its effects.

The wall lasts as long as you concentrate (as if concentrating on a spell), to a maximum of 1 minute, or until it's dispelled by a {@spell dispel magic|PHB} spell of 6th-level or higher, or until you are no longer holding the shield. Once this property of the shield has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Appraiser's Eye
item.reqAttune: by a creature missing an eye
entries: This golden sphere is the size of an eyeball with a bejeweled iris. Its weight is negligible. The sphere has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. Even if you aren't attuned to the sphere, you can use it and its charges for the following properties.

While holding the eye, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the {@spell identify|PHB} spell from it. Alternatively, you can use the eye as the material component required for the {@spell legend lore|PHB} spell. When you do, there is only a cumulative {@chance 10|10 percent} chance that the sphere is consumed by the spell.

While you're attuned to the sphere, it also functions like a normal eye while it's in your socket, and you have advantage on Intelligence checks you make to determine an item's value, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. In addition, if you cast {@spell legend lore|PHB} and use the sphere as the material component for the spell while you're attuned to it, the {@chance 10|10 percent} chance that the sphere is consumed by the spell isn't cumulative, and in the event that the sphere is consumed by the spell, it loses this property and can no longer be used as a component for the spell, but isn't destroyed.

item.name: Ao Hai's Fang
entries: This ancient sword was forged in a kingdom ruled by a tyrannical dragon that has long since sunken to the bottom of the ocean. While attuned to {@i Ao Hai's fang}, you are proficient with it. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which is a monk weapon for you.

entries.name: Dragon King's Wrath
entries: As a bonus action, you can spend 4 ki points to channel the fury of a powerful dragon and enter a magical rage. While raging in this way, you gain the following benefits:

items: If you aren't wearing armor, dragon-like scales cover your body, granting you a +1 bonus to AC.
You can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
You can make one attack with this weapon as a bonus action on each of your turns, and when you use your Flurry of Blows, you can make two attacks with this weapon instead of two unarmed strikes.
When a creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to make an attack with this weapon against that creature immediately after its attack.

entries: This rage lasts for 1 minute and ends early if you are knocked {@condition unconscious}. You can also end your rage on your turn as a bonus action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Angler's Worldly Fisher
entries: This magic fishing rod can be used anywhere on the Material Plane to fish from the world's waters. While holding this fishing rod, you can use an action to speak its command word and cast it at a point you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, the end of the line vanishes at the point and magically reappears somewhere else in the Material Plane in a random body of water. Despite not being able to see the end of the rod's line, you can still feel it being tugged at by the water's currents. Any fish you catch in this way reappear at the point where you cast the line. You have advantage on ability checks to catch fish while using this fishing rod.

item.name: Angler's Armor
entries: This magic armor was hand-made by a clan of proud fishers. The armor is made of countless hardened scales lining a reinforced leather jacket, making it a sturdy and weather proof option for sailors. While wearing this armor, you gain a swimming speed of 30 feet, and the normal and long ranges of nets are doubled for you. In addition, when you fish while wearing this armor, you catch twice as many fish as you normally would.

item.name: Amulet of the Spirit Naga
entries: While wearing this platinum pendant, you are immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition and have immunity to poison damage.

In addition, if you die while wearing the pendant, you immediately return to life with half your hit points. This property restores any missing body parts, neutralizes any poisons, and cures normal diseases afflicting you when you died, but has no effect if you die of old age. Once you're returned to life in this way, the amulet loses this property.

item.name: Amulet of the Sentinel
entries: This golden amulet of an eye has a large ruby embedded in its center and eight smaller gems around it. The amulet has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing this amulet, you can expend 1 or more of its charges to use one of the following properties:

entries.name: Alertness
entries: When you roll for initiative, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to add your proficiency bonus to the roll.

entries.name: Protection
entries: When a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you suffers a critical hit, you can use your reaction to expend 2 charges to turn that hit into a normal hit. Any effects triggered by a critical hit are canceled.

entries.name: Vigilance
entries: When one or more creatures that you can see within 30 feet of you are forced to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to expend 2 or more charges. For 2 charges, you grant one affected creature of your choice advantage on the saving throw. For each additional charge you expend, you grant one more affected creature of your choice advantage on the saving throw. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

item.name: Amulet of the Lycanthrope
entries: This rounded amulet depicts a harrowing crescent moon with blood-red claw marks running through its center. The markings emit a dim red light on the day of a full moon.

If you're not a lycanthrope, you can use a bonus action while wearing the amulet to assume a more bestial appearance, taking on the claws and defining features of either a bear, rat, tiger, or wolf (your choice). This transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 hit points or use a bonus action to revert to your normal form. For the duration, you can use your claws as natural weapons when making unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. In addition, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell for the duration of the transformation. This property can't be used again for 12 hours or until the next dusk, whichever comes first. Alternatively, if it's within 24 hours of a full moon, this property can be used again after 6 hours, instead of 12.

If you're already a lycanthrope and are wearing the amulet, your claw and bite attacks while in your animal or hybrid forms deal an extra {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage and count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. In addition, your bite attack save DC increases by 3.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This amulet is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you have disadvantage on saving throws made to resist becoming cursed by lycanthropy.

item.name: Amulet of Immutability
entries: This adamantine amulet protects you from magic that would threaten to alter your form against your will. While wearing the amulet, you have advantage on saving throws against transmutation spells of 5th level or lower that would transform or control you, such as {@spell enlarge/reduce|PHB}, {@spell levitate|PHB}, or {@spell slow|PHB}.
In addition, when you are targeted by the {@spell polymorph|PHB} spell, you can choose to automatically succeed on the saving throw.

item.name: Amulet of Buoyancy
entries: This well-worn necklace is adorned with the bow of a ship and a crashing wave of blue glass. While wearing this amulet, you can use your reaction to immediately stand up when you're knocked {@condition prone}. When you do, your speed is halved until the end of your next turn. In addition, if you start your turn underwater with 0 hit points, you immediately rise 60 feet toward the surface.

item.name: Ambitious Medic's Box
entries: This wooden box has two halves which are magically locked by ornamental clasps that can only be opened during certain times of the day. The box is 1 foot wide, 2 feet long, and weighs 3 pounds. You can open and use the box as normal, as described below, even if you aren't attuned to it.

The left side is locked by a metal clasp decorated with a sun. From dawn until dusk, you can open the left side of the box, which contains the same contents and functions identically to a {@item healer's kit|PHB}. Each day at dusk, the left side of the box magically closes and regains all expended uses of its healer's kit.

The right side is locked by a metal clasp decorated with a moon smoking a pipe. From dusk until dawn, you can open the right side of the box, which contains three pewter steins, a flask, and a wooden pipe. While holding the flask, you can use an action to speak its command word followed by either "beer", "wine", or "whiskey". When you do, the flask magically fills with up to 4 gallons of beer, 1 gallon of wine, or 8 ounces of liquor, depending on the chosen drink, which can be poured out as an action, up to 1 gallon per minute. Once this property of the flask has been used, it can't be used again until the next dusk. The wooden pipe is magically refilled with tobacco daily at dusk. Each day at dawn, the right side of the box magically closes, and anything removed from the box is magically returned to it.

While attuned to the box, you are proficient in the {@skill Medicine} skill and can open either side of the box at any time. If you're already proficient in the {@skill Medicine} skill, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses that skill.

item.name: Alchemist's Potion Belt
entries: This enchanted belt has two stoppers that magically resize to fit the mouth of any kind of bottle. The belt can carry up to two potions in this way. The belt can be worn comfortably around your waist or across your chest as a bandolier. While wearing the belt, any potion carried on it seems to magically unstopper and spring to your hand, allowing you to drink it as a bonus action. You can attach a bottle to the belt using an action.
When you roll a 1 on a Dexterity saving throw or are hit by a critical hit, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, one of the bottles on the belt shatters and is destroyed.

item.name: Air Render
entries: When you make a ranged attack with this magic bow, you can choose to fire a mote of wind instead of using an arrow. When you do, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls, and you can choose the form the wind takes, causing it to deal either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (your choice). When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made in this way, the target also suffers from one of the following effects:

entries.name: Bludgeoning Gust
entries: If the mote of wind dealt bludgeoning damage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} or pushed 15 feet away from you (your choice). If the target is Huge or larger, it automatically succeeds on the saving throw.

entries.name: Piercing Wind
entries: If the mote of wind dealt piercing damage, you can immediately make another attack with the same mote of wind against a different creature that is within 15 feet of the original target. This attack deals piercing damage.

entries.name: Slashing Tornado
entries: If the mote of wind dealt slashing damage, each other creature within 5 feet of the original target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} slashing damage.

item.name: Aged Goodberry Wine
entries: This bottle of thick red wine is miraculously made from magical goodberries and peonies using a closely kept family recipe. It tastes fruity and floral, with notes of honey and the feeling of a fresh breeze, and is deeply rejuvenating. The bottle comes with 8 servings of the syrupy potion, which each take 1 minute to drink.

When you drink this wine, you can regain hit points by spending any number of Hit Dice, as if you'd finished a short rest. You regain 1 extra hit point for each Hit Die you spend in this way. The wine provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. In addition, for the next hour, whenever you roll a Wisdom or Charisma ability check or saving throw, you add {@dice 1d4} to the total of the roll.

item.name: Adventurer's Overcoat
entries: This well-traveled and now faded overcoat has been worn by countless other mountaineering adventurers. A thin layer of frost hangs along the coat's hem. While wearing the coat, you and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you have resistance to cold damage.

item.name: Acorn Charm
entries: This small, polished acorn has been made into a magical bell that rings softly when moved. While wearing this charm, you have advantage on Charisma checks made to interact with plants, and you can communicate with plant creatures as if you shared a common language.

item.name: Aciurgist's Blade
entries: This smooth, magic glaive bears holy sigils and oaths down the length of its haft and is always impeccably clean. While holding it, your reach increases by 5 feet when using your Lay on Hands feature.

Once on each of your turns when you expend a spell slot to use your Divine Smite feature on an attack made with this glaive, you can choose one of the following effects to inflict on the target until the start of your next turn. When you expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can inflict an additional effect for each slot level above 1st, choosing each effect no more than once.

items: The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes.
The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet.
The next time the target takes damage, it takes an additional {@damage 1d8} necrotic or radiant damage (your choice).
The next attack made against the target is made with advantage.
The target can't regain hit points.

item.name: Abjurer's Bangle (Very Rare)
entries: You can clasp or remove this metal bracelet around the wrist or ankle of yourself or a willing creature within your reach using an action. The bangle emits a ward of abjuration magic from it that has 120 hit points. A creature wearing the bangle can use its reaction when it takes damage to speak the bangle's command word, causing the magical ward to take the damage instead. Any excess damage carries over to the creature when the bangle's ward is reduced to 0 hit points, at which point the bangle becomes a nonmagical bracelet.

item.name: Abjurer's Bangle (Uncommon)
entries: You can clasp or remove this metal bracelet around the wrist or ankle of yourself or a willing creature within your reach using an action. The bangle emits a ward of abjuration magic from it that has 30 hit points. A creature wearing the bangle can use its reaction when it takes damage to speak the bangle's command word, causing the magical ward to take the damage instead. Any excess damage carries over to the creature when the bangle's ward is reduced to 0 hit points, at which point the bangle becomes a nonmagical bracelet.

item.name: Abjurer's Bangle (Rare)
entries: You can clasp or remove this metal bracelet around the wrist or ankle of yourself or a willing creature within your reach using an action. The bangle emits a ward of abjuration magic from it that has 75 hit points. A creature wearing the bangle can use its reaction when it takes damage to speak the bangle's command word, causing the magical ward to take the damage instead. Any excess damage carries over to the creature when the bangle's ward is reduced to 0 hit points, at which point the bangle becomes a nonmagical bracelet.

item.name: Abjurer's Bangle
entries: You can clasp or remove this metal bracelet around the wrist or ankle of yourself or a willing creature within your reach using an action. The bangle emits a ward of abjuration magic from it that has a number of hit points determined by its rarity. A creature wearing the bangle can use its reaction when it takes damage to speak the bangle's command word, causing the magical ward to take the damage instead. Any excess damage carries over to the creature when the bangle's ward is reduced to 0 hit points, at which point the bangle becomes a nonmagical bracelet.

item.name: Wytchwood Sap
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition with this sticky sap and choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. A creature that takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition takes an extra {@damage 3d8} damage of the chosen type. Once applied, the sap retains its potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
Wytchwood Sap is stored in small vessels made of bark with a wooden stopper that never fully contains this oozing, amber-hued tar.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of your target takes {@damage 2d8} damage of the same type.

item.name: Tincture of Mourning
entries: When you drink this potion, you weep with inexpressible sorrow for 1 hour. During that time, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, but your continued wailing prevents you from being silent. If you are {@condition Charmed|XPHB} when you drink the potion, the condition is suppressed for the duration. This glass bottle is topped with a small crypt angel carved from stone. The fluid within has the taste and consistency of tears and the colors of a rain cloud.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: Creatures within 10 feet of you that are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you also gain {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Silence of the Drowned
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) as a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you for 10 minutes, and for the duration, squid tentacles emerge from your mouth.
This sculpted clay jar is painted in a deep blue and adorned with squid tentacles. Uncorking it reduces all noise in the area as if you are underwater, and the liquid within is a coppery blue-green.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: For the duration, you can spit ink from your mouth as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. One creature within 30 feet of you makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this property for the next 24 hours.

item.name: Sight of Sin
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of a {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) for 10 minutes, and during that time, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks to discern hidden motives or deception.
This potion is stored in a round glass flask. An iron band wraps around the bottle, ornamented with a goat's skull.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: For the duration, you also gain the effect of the {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} spell.

item.name: Reaper's Revenge
entries: When you drink this potion, you are filled with intense and violent vigor, gaining {@dice 3d8} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. For 1 minute, when one of your enemies dies within 30 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to regain {@dice 1d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
The base of this glass potion bottle is shaped like a skull, and the images of scythes run up its neck.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: For 1 minute after drinking this potion, when you hit a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, the creature takes an extra {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage.

item.name: Nightwatcher Potion
entries: When you drink this potion, you have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 120 feet for the next 24 hours. During that time, you don't need to sleep, and if you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can remain conscious throughout.
This clay bottle with a waxed stopper is painted with the head of a great horned owl, and the liquid within is midnight blue

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: The duration increases to 72 hours.

item.name: Nectar of the Green Man
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Commune with {@skill Nature|XPHB} spell, but your experience is filled with terror and dread. You must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, for the next 8 hours, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks while you can see a forest. You automatically succeed on the save if you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
This bottle is carved from wood, with a green, leafy face adorning its surface. The liquid is a deep green streaked with shades of umber.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: You can learn all five facts from Commune with {@skill Nature|XPHB}.

item.name: Lilypad Tonic
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required), turning you into a Frog.
This potion is found in a clay jar shaped and painted like a large frog, with a cork stopper in its back.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: The potion has six doses instead of one.

item.name: Jinxed Rum
entries: When you drink this brightly colored rum, your luck takes a strange turn for 1 hour. For the duration, when you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d4}. On a 2-4, add the number to your roll. On a 1, roll an extra {@dice d20} and use the lowest roll for the test.
This potion is stored in a glass rum bottle marked with crossbones.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: Roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

item.name: Harvest Brew
entries: When you drink this potion, you are filled with good health and bounty, providing you with enough nourishment to sustain you for 1 day. For the next hour, when you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you regain additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
The potion's bottle is made from a hollowed-out gourd, and the thick, liquid inside is a deep orange that tastes of nutmeg and cardamom.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: The additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} you regain are equal to half your level rather than your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (minimum +2).

item.name: Haint Hooch
entries: When you drink from this glass jug, you become insubstantial for 1 minute. During this time, you can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, taking {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside an object.
The potion is stored in jugs labeled "XxX," with a skeletal smile drawn on it. The ghastly, blue-green liquor within has an overpowering smell and harsh taste.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: For the duration, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

item.name: Elixir of Fogwalking
entries: When you drink this potion, your breath billows out in clouds of fog. For the next 10 minutes, fog and smoke don't hinder your vision, you can cast {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} up to three times (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required), and you can cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} up to three times as long as your teleportation begins or ends in an area of fog. This bottle has a base like cobblestone. The glass widens near the top before narrowing again into an iron cap, resembling a lantern. The liquid inside is a murky gray.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: The potion's duration becomes 1 hour, and when you use this potion to cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, you also gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Draught of the Red Hunger
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain a ravenous thirst for blood and gain the effect of the {@spell Vampiric Touch|XPHB} spell (level 6 version, no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) for 1 minute. You can repeat the attack on subsequent turns as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.
This liquid is a shimmering red deeper and more intense than natural blood.

entries.name: Heightened Potency
entries: For the duration, as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can gain the effects of the {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) while you aren't in sunlight. You can also revert to your normal form as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

item.name: Withered Hand
entries: The skin of this desiccated hand on a looped leather cord is covered with tattoos signifying dreadful hexes. The fingers seem to curl slightly when the hand is at the edge of your vision. While you hold or wear the hand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. The hand grants the following properties.

entries.name: Withering Grasp
entries: When you make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can extend your reach to 30 feet with threads of magenta jinx magic. When you do so, on a hit, you deal Necrotic damage instead of Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature no more than one size larger than you, you can give it the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition with the threads. The escape DC for this grapple can use your spellcasting ability or Charisma (your choice) in place of your Strength. The {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends if you use this property against a different target.

entries.name: Withering Curse
entries: When you use the Withering Grasp property, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 1. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum can't decrease again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You don't regain the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum lost to this curse when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Toy Riverboat
entries: This tiny, brightly painted boat is made in exacting detail, with smokestacks and a paddlewheel that turns, but it looks like a child's plaything. Studying it reveals a miniscule but unearthly passenger within the boat's cabin. The riverboat grants the following properties.

entries.name: Passengers
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you and up to twelve other willing, Medium or smaller creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself shrink to Tiny size and appear aboard the riverboat, along with up to 300 pounds of gear per passenger. The boat moves over water or other liquids at 3 miles per hour and doesn't require wind. You can travel this way for up to 12 hours a day. A passenger that leaves the boat returns to its normal size.

entries.name: Unearthly Passenger
entries: You can release the riverboat onto water to cast {@spell Arcane Eye|XPHB} with it. The riverboat is the spell's sensor and only moves on water, but you can otherwise move it as normal for the spell.

entries.name: Haunting Curse
entries: When a creature leaves the riverboat, it must make a DC 0 Charisma saving throw, becoming cursed on a failed save. While cursed in this way, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom and Charisma ability checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. After you make this saving throw, the save DC increases by 2. This increase can't happen again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: The Bag
entries: This weathered old satchel has three tarnished silver buckles that hold it shut. There are faint bloodstains on the inside of the flap, and the bag occasionally ripples as if something inside is moving. The bag functions as a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG} and has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Inhabitant
entries: A {@creature Lurker in the Dark|CrookedMoon24} lives in the bag's extradimensional space. If reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the lurker vanishes and reappears in the bag at the next midnight. The lurker only dies if it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by a creature holding a toy or stuffed animal once owned by a child. If the lurker is killed, the bag loses its magic, and anything in it appears in unoccupied spaces closest to the bag.

entries.name: The Bag's Claw
entries: While holding the bag, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to have the lurker in the dark lash out with its claw at a creature within 5 feet of you. Make a melee attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, the claw deals {@damage 1d10 + 4} Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC 14) from the claw, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

entries.name: Lurker's Curse
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1, the lurker slipped out of the bag during the rest and caused mayhem in a nearby area, such as attacking people, causing livestock to sicken, or spoiling provisions.

item.name: Revelry Suit
entries: This bulky suit is made from natural materials, including fur, canvas, and straw. Its mask is exceptionally oversized and shaped into a sun, smiling in an unsettling way. While you wear this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, and it grants the following properties.

entries.name: Dancing Dodge
entries: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, if your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't 0, you can use this property to succeed instead. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Wild Steps
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Dancing Curse
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you must make a DC 0 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you gain the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn as you perform a folk dance. When you use the Dancing Dodge or Wild Steps properties, the DC of the saving throw increases by 2. The DC of this curse can't increase again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Midwife Shears
entries: These scissors are shaped to resemble a stork. Their blades are forever wickedly sharp, and the threads they cut are more than merely physical.

entries.name: Cut the Unseen Thread
entries: While holding the scissors, you can cast {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} (+4 bonus) or {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} from them. Once either spell is cast from the scissors, that spell can't be cast from them again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Curse of the Severed Thread
entries: When you make a saving throw to avoid being pushed or to avoid the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you have a -1 penalty to the roll. This penalty increases by 1 each time you use the Cut the Unseen Thread property. If you fail such a save by 5 or more, you are pushed {@dice 1d6 x 5} feet straight away from the source of the save, in addition to any other distance pushed.

item.name: Jinxed Poker Chip
entries: This ceramic poker chip is painted with a crocodile's skull on one side. Hoarse laughter sounds when it flips. While you hold the chip, it grants the following properties.

entries.name: Jinxed Luck
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to flip the chip. Roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 4-6, you succeed on the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} instead. After you use this property, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1-5, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sense Cheating
entries: If you have proficiency with a {@item Gaming Set|XPHB}, you automatically succeed on ability checks to know if someone in a game you are playing is cheating.

entries.name: Cursed Coin
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you must succeed on a DC 0 Charisma saving throw or become cursed until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. While cursed, you subtract {@dice 1d6} from {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. When you use the Jinxed Luck property, the saving throw DC increases by 1.

item.name: Hypnovulfen Figure
entries: This carved wooden figurine depicts a crooked wolf with large, leering eyes and a wild, toothy maw. While holding the figure, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. The figure has the following properties.

entries.name: Hypnovulfen Bite
entries: Your teeth become viciously sharp. You can bite as an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} that deals {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage instead of Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hypnovulfen Eye
entries: While holding the figure, you can cast {@spell Confusion|XPHB} (save DC 14) with it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Cursed Hunger
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you must succeed on a DC 0 Wisdom saving throw or you can't use the {@action Attack|XPHB} or {@action Magic|XPHB} actions except to use the figure's properties until you hit a creature with a Hypnovulfen Bite attack. When you use the Hypnovulfen Eye property, the DC of this saving throw increases by 2.

item.name: Green Ribbon
entries: This green satin ribbon is just long enough to fasten around a person's neck comfortably. It's hard to think why you'd even want to remove it. While you wear the ribbon, you have a +5 bonus to {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}, and it grants the following properties.

entries.name: Instant Attunement
entries: If the ribbon is wrapped around the neck of a dead creature that has been dead no longer than 10 days and wasn't Undead when it died, the creature returns to life as if by a {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} spell, and it instantly attunes to the ribbon. The creature dies immediately if its {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to the ribbon ends or if the ribbon is removed.

entries.name: Ribbon's Mending
entries: When you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to immediately regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half your level (minimum 1). Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk or until you roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}.

entries.name: Curse of the Ribbon
entries: Creatures other than you within 60 feet of you have a -1 penalty to {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}. This penalty increases by 1 each time you use the Ribbon's Mending property.

item.name: Devilbone Button
entries: This bone button is found on an article of clothing, such as a shirt or coat, and is carved with the tiny image of a devil. It must be attached to clothing that you wear to attune to it. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws, and it has the following properties.

entries.name: Improbable Luck
entries: When you fail a saving throw while wearing the button, you can choose to succeed instead. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Protective Bone
entries: While wearing the button, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 5 + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Diabolic Curse
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, there is a {@chance 1} chance the button is mysteriously missing and your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to it ends. A devil with a CR of your level + 3 or CR 20 (whichever is lower) then becomes your enemy and seeks to destroy you. The GM determines the devil's details. When you use the Improbable Luck property, the chance the button disappears increases by 1.

item.name: Chunk of Oozing Fungus
entries: This fist-sized fungal growth is a pallid color, is oozy and lumpy, and frequently fills the air with spores. The fungus has the following properties.

entries.name: Spore Cloud
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can throw the fungus up to 30 feet. The fungus is destroyed and explodes into a cloud of spores in a 30-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point. Each creature other than you in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 3d8} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a target takes half damage only.

entries.name: Regrow
entries: You can grow another Chunk of Oozing Fungus by coughing green-black spores into your hand as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you do so, you must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 5.

entries.name: Fungal Curse
entries: You have a -1 penalty to Constitution saving throws. This penalty increases by 1 immediately after you succeed or fail on the saving throw from the Regrow property.

item.name: Bloody Fiddle
entries: This scarlet-lacquered fiddle is warm to the touch, like the heat of fresh blood. Though it looks like it has seen better days, its sound is clear and strong.
While you hold the fiddle, you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Song of Stirred Blood
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can play a lively or stirring tune on the fiddle. Up to six creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and if you have {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} dice, you can expend and roll one to add it to the total. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sanguine Curse
entries: The first time that you play the fiddle after finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you take 1 Slashing damage that ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}. When you use the Song of Stirred Blood property, this Slashing damage increases by 1.

item.name: Black Candle
entries: This broad, black tallow candle is engraved with arcane symbols. When lit, its smoke is greasy and pungent, and its flame is pale gray, but it never burns down. The candle has the following properties.

entries.name: Word of Flame and Darkness
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can light or extinguish the candle by speaking a command word while within 60 feet of it. It sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius.

entries.name: Witchlight
entries: While you are in the candle's light, you can cast a level 1 or 2 spell without expending a spell slot. When you cast a spell in this way, you can't cast that spell using the candle again for 24 hours, and you must succeed on a DC 0 Constitution saving throw or take Fire damage equal to {@dice 2d6} times the spell's level.

entries.name: Cursed Candle
entries: After you succeed or fail on the saving throw of the Witchlight property, its save DC increases by 2. This increase can't happen again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When the DC is 10 or higher, you also have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

item.name: Amber Birdcage
entries: This birdcage, shaped from amber, physically replaces your torso while you are attuned to it. When your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} ends, it separates from you, and your torso returns to its previous state. The birdcage has the following properties.

entries.name: Sense Fiends
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can sense the location of Fiends or magical effects created by Fiends within 60 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Capture Fiend
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose one {@status Bloodied|XPHB} Fiend that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. It must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be transformed into an amber songbird and trapped in the birdcage. The songbird is an inert object until removed from the cage and released. You can remove one songbird from the cage as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If you stop holding the bird, the Fiend reverts to its true form with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it is {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you.

entries.name: Consume Songbird
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can consume one amber songbird you are holding. The Fiend dies, and you can either regain one expended spell slot with a level up to half the Fiend's CR, or you can gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Fiend's CR.

entries.name: Amber Curse
entries: You have a -1 penalty to Wisdom saving throws. Each time you use the Capture Fiend or Consume Songbird properties, this penalty increases by 1.

item.name: Whistle of the Vagrant (Very Rare)
entries: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +2 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Call the Dead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB} on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} of any material other than iron or lead.

entries.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Call the Undead (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Banishment|XPHB} against an Undead creature (save DC = 16 + the whistle's bonus) from it. The target always appears in a harmless demiplane resembling the interior of a train. If you maintain the spell for its full duration, the target arrives in an appropriate afterlife. Creatures with Legendary Actions automatically succeed on the saving throw. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Steam Cloud (Very Rare+)
entries: You can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Touched by Death (Very Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

item.name: Whistle of the Vagrant (Rare)
entries: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +1 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Call the Dead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB} on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} of any material other than iron or lead.

entries.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Whistle of the Vagrant (Legendary)
entries: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Call the Dead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB} on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} of any material other than iron or lead.

entries.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Call the Undead (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Banishment|XPHB} against an Undead creature (save DC = 16 + the whistle's bonus) from it. The target always appears in a harmless demiplane resembling the interior of a train. If you maintain the spell for its full duration, the target arrives in an appropriate afterlife. Creatures with Legendary Actions automatically succeed on the saving throw. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Steam Cloud (Very Rare+)
entries: You can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Touched by Death (Very Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Afterlife Express (Legendary)
entries: You can blow the whistle to cast {@spell Ghastly Charge|CrookedMoon24} (takes the form of a ghost train) from it. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

item.name: Whistle of the Vagrant
entries: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws.

item.name: Visage of the Old Ways (Very Rare)
entries: This wood-carved mask has a haunted expression and makes the wearer's eyes look like empty shadows. Rabbit ears protrude over the head. While you wear the mask, you hear the whispers of an ancient forest archfey deep within your mind.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +4 bonus to your damage rolls when you deal Fire damage determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Cultic Mask (Rare+)
entries: You can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors. Ability checks made to discern your identity have a minimum DC of 25.

entries.name: Fire Within (Rare+)
entries: While you are burning, your weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 2d4} Fire damage. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to begin or stop burning.

entries.name: Strange Sight (Rare+)
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you can see normally through areas obscured by smoke.

entries.name: Mastery of Flame (Very Rare+)
entries: Fire damage you deal ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sacrificial Flame (Very Rare+)

item.name: Visage of the Old Ways (Rare)
entries: This wood-carved mask has a haunted expression and makes the wearer's eyes look like empty shadows. Rabbit ears protrude over the head. While you wear the mask, you hear the whispers of an ancient forest archfey deep within your mind.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +2 bonus to your damage rolls when you deal Fire damage determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Cultic Mask (Rare+)
entries: You can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors. Ability checks made to discern your identity have a minimum DC of 25.

entries.name: Fire Within (Rare+)

entries.name: Strange Sight (Rare+)
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you can see normally through areas obscured by smoke.

item.name: Veil of the Weeping Widow (Very Rare)
entries: This mourning veil is imbued with alien power. The Weeping Widow wore the veil to hide her permanently tear-stained face, and rumors circulate that the widow used it to hide the otherworldly corruption writhing within her eyes.
While wearing the veil, you gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws determined by the veil's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Psychic Fortitude (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Sense Grief (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus) from the veil.

entries.name: Psychic Shock (Very Rare+)
entries: When a creature forces you to make a saving throw against Psychic damage, or to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 2d8} Psychic damage to it.

entries.name: Thought Worm (Very Rare+)
entries: You can use the veil to cast {@spell Modify Memory|XPHB} (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus). When a creature fails its saving throw against the spell, you can implant a parasitic spawn of the White Worm in the target's brain. While you're on the same plane, you know the distance and direction to the target, and you can cast Divination and Enchantment spells on it as if it were in range and in sight. A Greater Restoration or {@spell Heal|XPHB} spell kills the parasite and ends this effect. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Tooth of the Jinxed Leviathan (Very Rare)
entries: This tooth is razor sharp and can be wielded as a Dagger. Its "hilt" is wrapped in alligator hide, and the flat of its blade flickers with magenta hex magic in carved glyphs.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the tooth, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Jinx of Dire Fortune (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can force one creature you can see within 60 feet of you to make a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the tooth's bonus). On a failed save, the target is jinxed for 1 minute. While jinxed, when the target makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and rolls an even number on the {@dice d20}, it must reroll the {@dice d20} and take the new roll. On a successful save, you must make the same saving throw, becoming jinxed for 1 minute on a failure. This property can't be used again while another creature is jinxed by it.

entries.name: Exposed Weak Spot (Very Rare+)
entries: When you make an attack roll with the tooth, you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

entries.name: Steal Unluck (Very Rare+)
entries: When an enemy you can see within 60 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to negate their {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until a creature you can see makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20}, or until the next dusk.

entries: This powerful, fiendish sword was once wielded by the Crimson Abbot. While it was created as a gift that brought evil and malice to the corrupted former knight, it has lost its connections to the Crimson Rose. However, its evil origins still linger within. The sword is sleek and polished, with a blade that absorbs light. A blood-red ruby on the hilt is fitted within a setting of thorns and roses.

item.name: Staff of Farryn of the Greenwood (Very Rare)
entries: This twisted wooden staff is crowned by a trinket-adorned deer's skull. It was fashioned by Farryn before she delved into the dark lore of Gorthos. Soft, fragrant moss and earthy mushrooms grow along the staff's length.

While holding the staff, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the staff's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Living Ward (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Servant of the Cycle (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} (level 3 version) from the staff. When you do so, the next time you hit with an attack before the end of your next turn, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

entries: You can cast {@spell Revivify|XPHB} from the staff. When you do so, the next time a creature fails a saving throw against a spell you cast in the next hour, it and creatures of your choice within 20 feet of it take {@damage 4d10} Necrotic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries: Crafted from polished gold and white enamel and adorned with an intricate design of a rose encircled by thorny vines, this Shield was once owned by Marius Renathyr, a knight-errant destined for a terrible fate.
While holding this Shield, you gain a +2 bonus to AC determined by the Shield's rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Valorous Guard (Rare+)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to add 2 + the Shield's bonus to the creature's AC, potentially causing the attack to miss. When a creature within 5 feet of you fails a Dexterity saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to add 2 + the Shield's bonus to the creature's total, potentially causing it to succeed.

entries.name: Honor of the Vanguard (Very Rare+)
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} and an ally you can see is within 30 feet of an enemy, you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that ally and gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 5 times the Shield's bonus.

entries.name: Righteous Wrath (Very Rare+)

item.name: Scythe of the Harvest Terror (Very Rare)
entries: This menacing scythe with a rusted blade was wielded by the Harvest Terror, a demon of secrets and fear. The scythe appears old and worn, with a handle wrapped in ancient, weathered cloth. The blade is etched with hatch marks, tallying its kills.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the scythe, you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Feed on Fear (Rare+)
entries: Once during your turn, when you attack with the scythe and hit a creature that has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, it takes an extra {@dice 1d10} (Legendary: {@dice 2d10}) Psychic damage.

entries.name: Sweep of Dread (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Fear|XPHB} (save DC = 16 + the scythe's bonus, no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) from the scythe. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Harvest of the Hidden Word (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can force one creature you can see that has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition to make a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the scythe's bonus). On a failed save, you learn one fact that it deliberately keeps secret. The creature is then immune to this property for 24 hours.

entries.name: Seed of Terror (Very Rare+)
entries: Immediately after you hit a creature with the scythe, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to force one creature within 30 feet of the creature you hit to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the Scythe's bonus). item.name: Runestone of the Wild Titan (Very Rare)
entries: This mighty granite runestone is etched with complex glyphs on much of its angular surface. Though an incredible burden to carry, it thrums with the power of the wild titan. The stone weighs 50 pounds.
While holding the stone, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws determined by the runestone's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Crushing Weight (Rare+)
entries: When you are within 5 feet of a creature with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to set the stone on the creature to give it the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The creature can take an action to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus), pushing the stone free and ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition on a success.

entries.name: Boulder Throw (Very Rare+)
entries: You can throw the stone as a Simple Ranged weapon using Strength for the attack and damage rolls. The stone has the Heavy and Thrown properties. It has a normal range equal to twice your Strength score and a long range equal to five times your Strength score. On a hit, it deals {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus) or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Recall (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can call the stone back to you, provided it is within 1 mile. If you have an empty hand, it appears in your hand; otherwise, it appears at your feet in your space.

item.name: Planchette of Adela Druskenvald (Very Rare)
entries: A small, heart-shaped silver pointer hangs from a silver necklace. It is inscribed with occult symbols. When placed on an open book or other assortment of letters, the air nearby feels heavy and cold.

While wearing the planchette, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom ability checks determined by the planchette's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Sense the Unseen (Rare+)
entries: The planchette has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dusk. You can expend charges to cast the following spells from it: {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} (1 charge), {@spell Locate Object|XPHB} (2 charges), {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} (2 charges).

entries.name: Starlight Ward (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage. When you take Radiant damage, for the next minute, the star-sigils on the planchette shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

entries.name: Vision Beyond (Very Rare+)
entries: The planchette now has 9 charges and regains {@dice 1d8 + 1} expended charges daily at dusk. You can also cast {@spell Find Traps|XPHB} (2 charges) and {@spell Sending|XPHB} (3 charges) from it.

entries.name: Spirit Ward (Very Rare+)
entries: When you fail a saving throw against the {@spell Magic Jar|XPHB} spell or possession (such as by a {@creature ghost|XMM}), you can expend 3 charges to succeed instead.

entries: This immaculate porcelain mask is painted with delicate violet filigree and once belonged to Lethica Nightborne—a priestess of a goddess of night and healing known as the Nightmother.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Gift of the Night Goddess (Rare+)
entries: You can see normally in magical and nonmagical {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

entries.name: Soothing Darkness (Rare+)
entries: Creatures of your choice in the area of a {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell that you cast have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage.

entries: You can cast {@spell Darkness|XPHB} from the mask. This property can be used twice (Very Rare+: four times), regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

item.name: Marotte of the Lord of Fools (Very Rare)
entries: This wooden fool's scepter is painted with vibrant, unsettling colors that depict a grinning face. While no creature is attuned to the marotte, the face looks like the infamous Chuckles, the Lord of Fools.

While holding the marotte, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the marotte's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Coulrophobia (Rare+)
entries: When you succeed on a saving throw to avoid the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force the creature that created the effect to make the same saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Fortune's Fool (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} (save DC = 16 + the marotte's bonus) from the marotte. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk. You regain use of the spell early if you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} for a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fool's Motley (Very Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell False Life|XPHB} from the marotte. Any clothing or armor you wear looks like a fool's motley for the duration of the spell.

entries.name: Slapstick (Very Rare+)
entries: When a creature is affected by a {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} spell you cast, you can choose another creature. When that creature deals damage to the target of the spell, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} rather than {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its saving throw to end the spell.

entries: You can cast {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} (save DC 19) from the marotte. The effect ends on a creature if it is behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} or more than 120 feet from you. A creature affected by your {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} automatically fails its saving throw against this Mass Suggestion. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Marotte of the Lord of Fools
entries: This wooden fool's scepter is painted with vibrant, unsettling colors that depict a grinning face. While no creature is attuned to the marotte, the face looks like the infamous Chuckles, the Lord of Fools.

While holding the marotte, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the marotte's rarity.
