item.name: Lantern of the Chained Reaper (Very Rare)
entries: This ornate Hooded Lantern was once a weapon in the hands of the Chained Reaper, filled with ghastly balefire. Able to pierce the veil, the lantern reveals a glimpse at things hidden from mortal eyes.

While you hold the lantern and it is lit, you gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks determined by the lantern's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Ghostly Flame (Rare+)
entries: The lantern doesn't require fuel, and it sheds blue-green light. It casts {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. You can snuff or ignite its light as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while you are within 30 feet of it.

entries.name: Revealing Flame (Rare+)
entries: Creatures in the Border Ethereal within the area of the lantern's {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} are visible to creatures on the Material Plane. When a creature within the lantern's {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} is possessed or affected by the {@spell Magic Jar|XPHB} spell, the creature in control appears overlaid on the body in a spectral form.

entries.name: Mystic Sight (Very Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} from the lantern. The spell ends early if you extinguish the light or aren't holding the lantern.

entries.name: Summon Spirit (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can summon a {@creature Ghost|XMM} that appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you. The ghost obeys your commands, and it takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. The ghost vanishes after 1 minute, or when it dies. You can't use the lantern's properties, except for Ghostly Flame, during this time.

item.name: Hook of the Tall Man (Very Rare)
entries: This hook is made from a single huge claw attached to a large bleached fingerbone mounted on a haft of ash. The tip of the claw gives off an eerie glow. The finger and claw were cut from the hand of the Tall Man.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the hook's rarity. While holding the hook, you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Snare (Rare+)
entries: When you hit a creature with the hook, you can activate the {@itemMastery Topple|XPHB} mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with it.

entries.name: Fey Haunt's Stride (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} from the hook, and when you do so, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check made before the end of your next turn. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses when you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}.

item.name: Idol of the Beast of Blight (Very Rare)
entries: Made of bleached and mutated bone, this idol in the shape of a stag contains the sinister knowledge of the Beast of Blight. It pulses with the power of rot and decay.

While holding the idol, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the idol's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Rotting Touch (Rare+)
entries: You can use your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}, and on a hit, your strike deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage (Rare), {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage (Very Rare), or {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage (Legendary).

entries.name: Touch of Oblivion (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch a creature that has been dead for less than 1 hour. It rots away to bleached bone and can't be used for this property again. The next time you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} using the Rotting Touch property before the end of your next turn, it is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} instead.

entries.name: Hallucinatory Spores (Very Rare+)
entries: When you cast a spell using a spell slot or from the idol, you can choose one creature that you can see within 10 feet of you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the idol's bonus) or take {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage and have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Rot in the Flesh (Very Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Barkskin|XPHB} from the idol targeting only yourself. For the duration, a creature that hits you with a melee attack roll takes {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage. Once the spell is cast from the idol, it can't be cast from it again until the next dusk.

item.name: Hide of the Brimstone Behemoth (Very Rare)
entries: This cloak was made from the hide of a reptilian magma Fiend, incomparable in its destructive power. Flame now shies away from it, for one who has mastered such a titanic creature can master its element.
While wearing this cloak, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} and Constitution saving throws determined by the cloak's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Deep-Dweller (Rare+)
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage and a {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. Once during your turn when you emerge from burrowing, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the hide's bonus), taking {@damage 2d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Infernal Roar (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Fear|XPHB} (save DC = 16 + the hide's bonus) from the cloak. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

entries.name: Hellfire Maw (Very Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can exhale hellfire in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the hide's bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} Fire damage and {@damage 4d6} Necrotic damage, and it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for 1 minute. item.name: Eye of the White Worm (Very Rare)
entries: This fist-sized eyeball is cold and clammy to the touch. It is milky-white with purple veins, and its pupil constantly searches for something.

While holding the eye, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the eye's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Thought Scour (Rare+)

item.name: Cutlass of Briggsy Kratch (Very Rare)
entries: A fearsome weapon imbued with jinxcraft magic, this cutlass was once wielded by the notorious pirate captain, Briggsy "The Kutlass" Kratch. Its tarnished blade glimmers with a faint, otherworldly light. A skull and crossbones adorn the leather-wrapped hilt, and arcane symbols etched into the blade pulse with hidden power.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with the cutlass determined by its rarity. While holding the cutlass, you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Raise the Stakes (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose a creature within 5 feet of you and mark it until the start of your next turn. Count the number of times you hit the target and the number of times it hits you while the mark lasts. If you hit the target more times, it takes {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. If it hits you more times, you take {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. If your hits are tied, you both take {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sea Legs (Rare+)
entries: When you take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of that turn.

entries.name: Double Down (Very Rare+)
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack against a target marked by the Raise the Stakes property.

entries.name: Jinxcraft Panache (Very Rare+)
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to increase your AC against that attack by twice the cutlass's bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature already dealt damage to you on this turn.

item.name: Cutlass of Briggsy Kratch (Rare)
entries: A fearsome weapon imbued with jinxcraft magic, this cutlass was once wielded by the notorious pirate captain, Briggsy "The Kutlass" Kratch. Its tarnished blade glimmers with a faint, otherworldly light. A skull and crossbones adorn the leather-wrapped hilt, and arcane symbols etched into the blade pulse with hidden power.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with the cutlass determined by its rarity. While holding the cutlass, you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Raise the Stakes (Rare+)
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose a creature within 5 feet of you and mark it until the start of your next turn. Count the number of times you hit the target and the number of times it hits you while the mark lasts. If you hit the target more times, it takes {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. If it hits you more times, you take {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. If your hits are tied, you both take {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Sea Legs (Rare+)
entries: When you take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of that turn.

item.name: Crown of the Barrow King (Very Rare)
entries: This crown of twisted iron has five sharp, tall spikes that are crusted with dried blood. None who see it doubt the malice and corruption that the Barrow King imbued into it.

While you wear the crown, you gain a +2 bonus determined by the crown's rarity to spell attack rolls and to your spell save DC for Necromancy spells and spells that deal Necrotic damage, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Demand of the Dead (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Speak with Dead|XPHB} from the crown.

entries.name: Grave Grasp (Rare+)
entries: You know the {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} cantrip. Your spell attack bonus with it is +9 (Rare), +10 (Very Rare), or +11 (Legendary).

entries.name: Necromancer's Call (Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB} from the crown. It can be used to cast this spell three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

entries.name: Master of Undeath (Very Rare+)
entries: Undead that you create or summon have twice as many {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} as normal and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws.

entries.name: Soul Transfer (Very Rare+)
entries: When you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fail a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}, you can transfer your soul into an Undead that you created and that is within 1 mile of you (no action required). Your previous body dies instantly. Your new body has none of your possessions except the crown. You use your game statistics, except the target Undead's current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} replace your current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Cauldron of the Vermintoll Coven (Very Rare)
entries: The tarnished cauldron bubbles with a strange, dark liquid. Even in transport, the liquid stays within the rune-emblazoned rim of the cauldron.

While you hold the cauldron, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus determined by the cauldron's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Size Change (Rare+)
entries: You can perform a 1-minute ritual to change the cauldron's size from Tiny to Medium, or from Medium to Tiny. It weighs 1 lb. when Tiny and 80 lb. when Medium. As a Medium object, its feet can move. It has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 20 feet and moves when you command it during your turn (no action required).

entries.name: Cookpot (Rare+)
entries: As part of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can use the Medium cauldron to prepare food for up to ten creatures. At the end of the rest, each creature that eats gains {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vermincall (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can spill liquid from the cauldron to cast {@spell Conjure Animals|XPHB} with it. The conjured spirits take the form of grotesque insects or rats. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Fortifying Gorge (Very Rare+)
entries: When you use the Cookpot property, one creature of your choice who eats gains a +2 bonus to AC until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. During this time, the creature's skin is hardened and monstrous.

When the effect ends, the creature has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for 1 minute from the agony of its bones shrinking slower than its flesh.

item.name: Cane of Phillip Druskenvald (Very Rare)
entries: This ornate cane is made from polished black wood and is topped with a silver goat-skull ornament. Even a glance at it sparks greed and envy in all but the truly humble.

While holding the cane, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the cane's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Eldritch Glutton (Rare+)
entries: When you succeed on a saving throw against a spell that targets only you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to consume the spell and store its energy in the cane. The spell has no effect on you. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to absorb the stored energy to either regain an expended spell slot that is at least one level lower than the triggering spell or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to three times the spell's level. If you absorb a new spell while the cane holds spell energy, the previous energy is lost. Once the cane absorbs a spell, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Allure of Sin (Very Rare+)
entries: You can cast {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB} (save DC = 16 + the cane's bonus) from the cane. Once a creature is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the spell, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can summon three Hell Hounds, one Incubus, or one Succubus. After 10 minutes, they no longer obey you, but if you treated them well, they are {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} or {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} toward you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Blunderbuss of the Grinning Sinner (Very Rare)
entries: This dark, ornate blunderbuss has a brass barrel and a wooden handle etched with arcane symbols. It was the Grinning Sinner's weapon of choice, who imbued it with the power to shoot jinxes and hexes.

The blunderbuss functions as a {@item Musket|XPHB} that ignores {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading}, and it can make its own ammunition that deals Necrotic damage on a hit. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it determined by the blunderbuss's rarity. While holding the blunderbuss, you can use the blunderbuss as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Jinxshot (Rare+)
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a blast from the blunderbuss that forces each creature within a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} to make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 16 + the blunderbuss's bonus), taking {@damage 2d4} Necrotic damage (Rare) or {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage (Very Rare+) on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Sinner's Jinx (Very Rare+)
entries: Once during your turn when you damage a creature with the blunderbuss, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the blunderbuss's bonus) or be cursed for 1 minute. When it makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} while cursed, it subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the total. The curse ends if this property is used on another creature.

item.name: Bell of the Dusk Mother (Very Rare)
entries: This heavy iron handbell is elaborately decorated with filigree. Its handle is a large ring, and its clapper hangs from a chain within. Its only sound is ever-mournful tolling.

While holding the bell, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by its rarity, and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Dolorous Tolling (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can ring the bell, producing an ominous tolling. Creatures of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the bell's bonus). On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 3d10} Psychic damage, and for 1 minute, when it makes an attack roll or saving throw, it must subtract {@dice 1d4} from the total. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

The doll obeys your commands and acts immediately after your turn on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}. It reverts to the materials used to create it after 10 minutes or when it dies. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Death Knell (Legendary)
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can ring the bell, creating a loud clang. Each {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 5d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

item.name: Bell of the Dusk Mother
entries: This heavy iron handbell is elaborately decorated with filigree. Its handle is a large ring, and its clapper hangs from a chain within. Its only sound is ever-mournful tolling.
While holding the bell, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by its rarity.
items: Bell of the Dusk Mother (Very Rare)|CrookedMoon24

item.name: Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks (Very Rare)
entries: An old, weathered banjo inscribed with runes, this instrument once belonged to Ol' Jericho Sticks, a scarecrow bard created by a hag coven.

While holding the banjo, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells; you gain a +2 bonus determined by its rarity to spell attack rolls, your spell save DC, and Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks; and you can use the following properties.

entries.name: Fiendish Lure (Rare+)
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, choose one Fiend or Humanoid that you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the banjo's bonus) or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (ignoring a demon's {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}) for 1 minute. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition ends if you or your allies deal damage to the target or force it to make a saving throw. Once a creature is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} in this way, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

entries.name: Scarecrow's Dance (Rare+)
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to strum the banjo and dance wildly to take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. The music is audible within 120 feet.

entries.name: Join in the Dance (Very Rare+)
entries: When you use Scarecrow's Dance, one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Birdcage (Legendary)
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can force a creature you have {@condition Charmed|XPHB} to make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature disappears, drawn into the banjo. The banjo can contain one creature at a time in this way for up to 24 hours. On a success, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition ends on the creature.

item.name: Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks
entries: An old, weathered banjo inscribed with runes, this instrument once belonged to Ol' Jericho Sticks, a scarecrow bard created by a hag coven.

items: Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks (Very Rare)|CrookedMoon24

item.name: Axe of the Galloping Headsman (Very Rare)
entries: This axe has a wickedly curved head, honed to a razor's edge and lined with dark fire. It's handle is wrapped in cracked leather, and the entirety is etched with malevolent runes.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the axe's rarity. You can also use the following properties.

entries.name: Fiery Smite (Rare+)
entries: This axe deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage on a hit. If the target is a creature that damaged you since the end of your last turn, the extra damage becomes {@dice 1d10}.

entries.name: Mark of Guilt (Very Rare+)
entries: When you hit a creature with the axe, you can mark it for punishment (no action required). You know the direction and distance to the creature. If it leaves this plane of existence, you know the destination plane and the mark ends. The mark otherwise ends when this property is used again, or when the target dies.

entries.name: Sense Guilt (Very Rare+)
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to hold the blade of the axe to a creature's neck (if it has one), and it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the axe's bonus) or you learn something the creature feels guilty about. Once this property is used, the target is immune to it for 24 hours.

item.name: Axe of the Galloping Headsman (Rare)
entries: This axe has a wickedly curved head, honed to a razor's edge and lined with dark fire. It's handle is wrapped in cracked leather, and the entirety is etched with malevolent runes.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the axe's rarity. You can also use the following properties.

entries.name: Dark Binding (Legendary)
entries: Once during your turn when you hit a creature with the axe, you can immediately take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to force the target to succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} and {@condition Prone|XPHB} conditions until the start of your next turn. If its body shape allows it, the target kneels and presents its neck.

entries.name: Executioner's Blade (Legendary)
entries: When you attack a creature with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition using the axe, you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}. On a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, the axe deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Fire damage, and if the creature is left with 20 or fewer {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} after taking this damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or die.

item.name: Axe of the Galloping Headsman
entries: This axe has a wickedly curved head, honed to a razor's edge and lined with dark fire. It's handle is wrapped in cracked leather, and the entirety is etched with malevolent runes.
You gain a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by the axe's rarity.
items: Axe of the Galloping Headsman (Very Rare)|CrookedMoon24

item.name: Absorbing Tattoo
entries: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features designs that emphasize one color.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: While the tattoo is on your skin, you have resistance to a type of damage associated with that color, as shown on the table below. The DM chooses the color or determines it randomly.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: When you take damage of the chosen type, you can use your reaction to gain immunity against that instance of the damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage you would have taken. Once this reaction is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Harkon's Bite
entries: A dire wolf's tooth dangles from this simple cord necklace. You gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws while you wear this necklace.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This necklace is cursed. Attuning to the necklace curses you; this curse can't be removed until {@creature Harkon Lukas|RHW} dies. As long as you remain cursed, you become a {@creature Werewolf|XMM} serving Harkon Lukas under the DM's control during the night of a full moon.

item.name: Ebonbane
entries: The Darklord of the Domain of Dread known as the Shadowlands is Ebonbane, a sapient sword. {@creature Ebonbane|RHW} uses its monster stat block while in Shadowborn Manor.

entries.name: Bound to the Shadowlands
entries: When you enter a space outside of the Shadowlands, your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} immediately ends and Ebonbane teleports to somewhere in Shadowborn Manor.

entries.name: Insatiable Rage
entries: The sword demands destruction. If the sword hasn't slain a Celestial or a Humanoid for 3 days, you make a DC 17 Charisma saving throw at the next dawn. On a successful save, you take {@damage 8d8} Force damage. On a failed save, you are dominated by the sword, as if by the {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB} spell, and the sword demands the blood of a Celestial or a Humanoid. The spell effect ends when the sword's demand is met.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Celestial or a Humanoid with it, that attack also deals {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage.
While you hold this weapon, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Ebonbane is a sentient Chaotic Evil weapon with an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 14, and a Charisma of 19. It has hearing and {@sense Truesight|XPHB} out to 120 feet. The weapon speaks Common and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. While you are attuned to it, Ebonbane also understands every language you know.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Ebonbane was created to kill the paladin Kateri Shadowborn, and it still possesses a burning hatred for goodly knights. Ebonbane revels in seeing good defeated and hope vanquished. The sword bonds with any wielder that assists in its goals but always views it wielder as a lackey.

entries.name: Destroying Ebonbane
entries: The only way to destroy Ebonbane is to forge a weapon from the Four Keys and reduce Ebonbane to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with it (see the Ebonbane stat block).

item.name: Devastation Orb
entries: A devastation orb is an elemental bomb that can be created at the site of an elemental node by performing a ritual with an elemental weapon. The type of orb created depends on the node used. For example, an air node creates a {@item devastation orb of air|PotA}. The ritual takes 1 hour to complete and requires 2,000 gp worth of special components, which are consumed.

A devastation orb measures 12 inches in diameter, weighs 10 pounds, and has a solid outer shell. The orb detonates {@dice 1d100} hours after its creation, releasing the elemental energy it contains. The orb gives no outward sign of how much time remains before it will detonate. Spells such as {@spell identify} and {@spell divination} can be used to ascertain when the orb will explode. An orb has AC 10, 15 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Reducing it to 0 hit points causes it to explode instantly.

A special container can be crafted to contain a devastation orb and prevent it from detonating. The container must be inscribed with symbols of the orb's opposing element. For example, a case inscribed with earth symbols can be used to contain a {@item devastation orb of air|PotA} and keep it from detonating. While in the container, the orb thrums. If it is removed from the container after the time when it was supposed to detonate, it explodes {@dice 1d6} rounds later, unless it is returned to the container.
Regardless of the type of orb, its effect is contained within a sphere with a 1 mile radius. The orb is the sphere's point of origin. The orb is destroyed after one use.

item.name: Mind Crystal
entries: These gemstones contain a crystallized bit of spellcasting magic. Different types of mind crystals exist, each with a different single-use effect.

When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action while holding a mind crystal, you can modify the spell in a specific way. You can use only a single mind crystal to modify the spell, and you can't use a mind crystal and a Metamagic option on the same spell. Once you use a mind crystal, it becomes a nonmagical gem worth 50 gp.

item.name: Molten Bronze Skin

entries: This magical armor appears as a jug of molten bronze. When you attune to it, the bronze adheres and contours to your skin. The armor can be worn under normal clothes, but it doesn't impede bodily functions. Once you put it on, it can't be removed unless you choose to do so.
While wearing the armor, you have resistance to fire damage. The armor also doesn't impose disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

This magical armor appears as a jug of molten bronze. When you attune to it, the bronze adheres and contours to your skin. The armor can be worn under normal clothes, but it doesn't impede bodily functions. Once you put it on, it can't be removed unless you choose to do so.
While wearing the armor, you have resistance to fire damage. The armor also doesn't impose disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

item.name: Whirling Bonesaw
entries: This large greataxe is made from a blade taken off a Ripper and refitted into a housing made from the plates of constructs and reinforced with the rib bones of a monstrosity. The blade is equipped with a leather belt that connects to an elemental-fueled motor powered by a Very Rare Animus.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
Once on your turn when you hit a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature using this weapon, you can make one additional attack with this weapon as part of the same action.

item.name: Vampire Blood Potion
entries: This potion is a crimson-red bubbling brew that tastes distinctly of copper. When you drink this potion, you gain the following benefits for the next minute:

items: You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength, Dexterity, and Charisma attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

If damage reduces you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + half the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, you drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead, and the effects of this potion end.
The effects of this potion end early if you take Radiant damage or enter sunlight.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Vampire Blood Potion requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Undead Animus

items.name: [Dust]
entries: Undead Dust from any Vampire

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Ectoplasm

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Monster Blood from a Vampire

item.name: Trollblood Potion
entries: This potion is a bubbling, sickly, green-brown viscous soup that has the consistency of mucus. What appears to be the rotting eye of a troll floats in the potion. It smells acrid and nauseating and tastes even worse than it looks.
When you drink this potion, for the next minute, you regain 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of your turn. The effects of this potion end early if you take Fire or Acid damage.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Trollblood Potion requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Fey Animus

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Monster Blood from a Troll

items.name: [Organ]
entries: Eyes from a Troll

item.name: Time Dilation Medallion
entries: The inner workings of this clockwork device are formed from gears forged from magical constructs gathered around a focusing lens, held together carefully by the needles of magical creatures. The animus used harnesses the energy of The Algorithm, a being of order and consequence, whose control over time and space ripples from the strange clockworks of the medallion.
This medallion has 3 charges. It crumbles to dust when you expend the final charge.

You can expend 1 charge from the medallion to take an extra action on your turn. Each time you do, you can roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1, at the end of your turn, you become unstuck in time and space as the medallion casts the {@spell Maze|XPHB} spell on you. On a 6, the medallion regains {@dice 1d3} charges.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating the Time Dilation medallion requires a Legendary Workshop and the following Legendary Components:

items.name: [Natural Weapon]
entries: Any Needles

items.name: [Organ]
entries: Eye from a Construct

item.name: Tentacle Whip
entries: This whip is made from the tentacles and guts of aberrant creatures, stitched to the webbed membranes of winged beasts and fused to the bark of a plant creature. Once the animus is placed, the tentacles begin to writhe and wriggle and the whip can latch and drag creatures along the ground with uncanny strength.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic whip, which has a reach of 20 feet.
Once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack using this weapon, you can pull it 10 feet towards you.

item.name: Talon Gloves
entries: These leather gloves are outfitted with the talons of fallen beasts and stitched together with the arcane stitching of apothecary creations. The gloves are then empowered by elemental magic, reinforced with bone, and powered by an animus.

While wearing these gloves, you gain {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal an additional {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage on a hit.

entries: While wearing these supple leather boots, {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

item.name: Scythed Arm Blades
entries: These steel arm blades are razor sharp, 4-foot-long scythes that are fastened to two locking bracers made of spinal bones. The fasteners are made from fine leather with steel buckles. Delerium crystals are embedded in the armbands, infusing the blades with energy.
These magic shortswords function as a pair and must be wielded together for their magic properties to function. Attuning to the shortswords counts as being attuned to one magic item.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with these magic shortswords. While attuned to these weapons, you can activate the Nick mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with these weapons.

item.name: Scroll of Spell Power
entries: When you roll damage for a spell of level 1 or higher, you can expend this scroll to re-roll a number of the damage dice up to the level of the spell cast. You must use the new rolls.

item.name: Retracer Boots
entries: These boots are crafted from the flesh and scales of a dragon and decorated with Harpy feathers and the webbed membranes of flying creatures. The soles are injected with goopy ooze, allowing their wearer to jump back in time and space.

You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn to click the heels of these boots together. When you do, you teleport to the space you occupied at the start of your turn so long as it is currently unoccupied.

item.name: Rejuvenation Potion
entries: When you drink this bright purple potion, you immediately gain the benefits of a short rest.
After you consume a Rejuvenation Potion, you can't benefit from consuming another until you finish a {@dice 1d4} Long Rests.

item.name: Reflector Shield
entries: This magic shield is formed from the shell of an Anomollusk combined with leather from an aberration as its handle. It's fused together and coated in contaminated ichor and inset with a rare animus. Once complete, the shell gives off an otherworldly hue that shimmers in kaleidoscopic patterns. The shield can reflect attacks and magic.

When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, or Thunder damage from a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause the creature to take the same damage (you still take the damage).

item.name: Rat Tooth Dagger
entries: When you hit with an attack as part of an {@action Attack|XPHB} action using this magic dagger and apply your Sneak Attack to the damage roll, you can make an additional attack using this dagger as part of the same action. If that attack hits and meets the criteria for your Sneak Attack, you can apply half your Sneak Attack dice (rounded down) to the attack's damage.

item.name: Potion of Controlled Mutation
entries: This sickly-looking potion contains a writhing mass of tentacles that animate and uncomfortably crawl down the imbiber's throat when consumed. The taste is pungent and fishy, and results in the sudden outbreak of random, but temporary, mutations.

When you consume this potion, you gain the effects of one randomly determined Mutation until you start a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can roll on the {@table Mutations|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} table twice, choosing which mutation manifests. You don't gain any {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels as a result of this Mutation. When the effect ends, your body returns to normal.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Potion of Controlled Mutation requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Animus from an Aberration

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Contaminated Ichor

items.name: [Organs]
entries: Any two Organs from an Aberration

item.name: Pendant of Prismatic Protection
entries: The jeweled pendant has 3 charges, which are replenished when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 1 charge from the pendant to gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Pendant of Prismatic Protection requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Any Animus from an Elemental

items.name: [Dust]
entries: Elemental Dust

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Any two Elemental Fluids from different Elementals

item.name: Pelt of the Pack Lord
entries: This pelt cape is made from the fur of a Garmyr stitched carefully into the leathers of a ratling, decorated with the talons of a harpy, and polished to a shine with contaminated ichor.
While you are attuned to this pelt and are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, your allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature.

item.name: Necromancer's Armor

entries: This suit of armor is constructed from the bones of the dead and outfitted over black woven fabric. The armor has two skulls as pauldrons upon the shoulders, a reinforced spine, and a rib cage that covers the front, and the entire structure is ornately decorated with the fangs of fallen beasts. The bones are magically imbued with otherworldly energy, powered by a powerful undead animus.
While attuned to this armor, you are proficient with this armor even if you lack proficiency with light armor.

While you are within 30 feet of an Undead creature under your control, you gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage except Radiant. However, each time you take damage, choose an Undead creature under your control within 30 feet of you. That creature takes the same amount of damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

item.name: Monster Hunter's Weapon +3

entries: These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} in this way it does not require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} again using either the weapon or otherwise.

item.name: Mask of Monstrous Forms
entries: This magic mask is made from the skull of a particular monstrosity (with a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of 6 or lower). The skull is carved into a mask, engraved with aberrant dust, and then boiled in a vat of mimic mucus, the flesh of a doppelganger, and acidic bile. Finally, a vessel containing the animus of any creature with the Shapechanger trait is placed upon the forehead of the mask, channeling its shapechanging magic.
While attuned to the mask, you can expend two uses of your Wild Shape feature to transform into the monstrosity associated with the mask, instead of a Beast.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Mask of Monstrous Forms requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Animus from a creature that has the Shapechanger trait

items.name: [Bones]
entries: Skull of a Monstrosity*

items.name: [Dust]
entries: Aberrant Dust

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Acidic Bile

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Mucus from a Mimic

items.name: [Organ]
entries: Flesh from a Doppelganger
{@i * The Monstrosity used for this mask determines the form of the shapechange.}

item.name: Manual of Occult Anatomy +3
entries: Filled with diagrams showing humans with alien features, this book of strange medical lore is written in monster-blood ink infused with draconic dust and then etched onto parchment pages made from aberration skin. The manuscript is bound in a scale-clad cover.

You can use this manual as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Apothecary or Warlock spells. When you use the manual as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs of your Apothecary or Warlock spells.

In addition, the book contains the knowledge of an Apothecary Esoteric Theory or Warlock Eldritch Invocation up to a level determined by the manual's rarity and chosen when the item is created, which you gain while you are attuned to it. This determines which class is required to attune to the item.

entries.name: Crafting
entries: Creating a Manual of Occult Anatomy requires a Workshop and Components of equal rarity to the item created. The Components required are:

items.name: [Animus]
entries: Any Animus

items.name: [Dust]
entries: Any Dragon Dust

items.name: [Fluid]
entries: Monster Blood from a Monstrosity

items.name: [Hide]
entries: Scales

items.name: [Hide]

item.name: Manual of Occult Anatomy +2
entries: Filled with diagrams showing humans with alien features, this book of strange medical lore is written in monster-blood ink infused with draconic dust and then etched onto parchment pages made from aberration skin. The manuscript is bound in a scale-clad cover.

You can use this manual as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Apothecary or Warlock spells. When you use the manual as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs of your Apothecary or Warlock spells.

In addition, the book contains the knowledge of an Apothecary Esoteric Theory or Warlock Eldritch Invocation up to a level determined by the manual's rarity and chosen when the item is created, which you gain while you are attuned to it. This determines which class is required to attune to the item.

item.name: Injector's Crossbow

entries: This crossbow is covered in metal plating, decorative and refined pointed metal tips along an oak wood body, and foregrip. The barrel and limb are reinforced with the steel plates from a construct, with a stained leather grip made from a monster's hide. Its hair strung bowstring and leather fasteners hold a series of syringes in place. The crossbow's stock has a series of various tubes extruding from it that connect to an alchemical chamber on the side of the weapon. A mechanical wheel feeds the darts into place upon filling them, auto-loading the crossbow for easy firing.

You gain a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic crossbow. This crossbow ignores {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading}, and you don't need a free hand to load a piece of ammunition into it.
Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged attack using this crossbow, you can apply one of the following poisons.

entries.name: Virulent
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Poison damage.

entries.name: Weakening
entries: The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Immobilizing
entries: The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Inexhaustible Armor

entries: This armor is made from fey leathers and magical plates, infused with the chemical solutions found in some constructs and empowered with the heart of a gorgon.

While attuned to this armor, you gain an additional use of your Second Wind class feature. In addition, when you use your Second Wind, you regain an additional {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and can remove one of the following conditions from yourself: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

base.name: Ring-Mail
entries: This armour is leather armour with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armour against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armor.

entries: This helm is forged in fires ignited with elemental dust, using plates from a construct and the heart of a red dragon. The plates are then soaked in elemental fluid before having an animus gem installed that contains the energy of a Fire Giant.

While your Rage is active, you gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. In addition, once per turn, while you are Raging, when you hit a target with a Melee weapon that benefitted from your Reckless Attack feature, the target becomes {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d4} Fire).

item.name: Heart String Harp

entries: When played, this instrument reverberates with draconic whispers and enchantment that drift subtly within the notes that are struck, giving the music a sense of foreboding and palpable charm. Crafted from finely polished ivory and imbued with the animus of a fey creature, the true magic of this harp comes from the finely crafted strings made from combining the sinew of a dragon's heart chords and the hair of a fey, willingly given out of kindness.
You can use this magical harp as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Bard spells. While attuned to this item, you gain a +1 bonus to your spell attack rolls and spell save DC.

When you cast an Enchantment spell of level 1 to level 5 that targets only one creature using this harp as the {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can target a second creature within the spell's range.

item.name: Hammer of Chaos

entries: A hammer of chaos is crafted by melting down the magical plates of otherworldly constructs, infused with both the fluid and dust of elementals. The weapon is then soaked in the grey matter of an aberrant brain. This steel hammer is fitted into a shaft made from fiend skin leather and the ribs of a dragon.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon. This hammer has {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 90 feet. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. The hammer deals {@damage 2d8} extra damage of the chosen type.

When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, if you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the hammer ricochets to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll if the attack hits. After making this attack, the hammer flies back to your hand.

item.name: Giant Femur Club
entries: This club is made from the cleaned and polished femur of a giant, crafted finely into a usable two-handed club. Its tapered hilt is wrapped in stained leather. Fastened to the top of the club is a large troll skull with several monstrous teeth embedded into it like a bone morningstar, giving the weapon a grim appearance. The club is imbued with elemental power from the animus used to power the weapon, which causes it to crackle with elemental power.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic greatclub, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls made against Giants.
While attuned to this club you deal an additional {@damage 2d6} damage of the type associated with the elemental dust infused into it.

item.name: Ghost Sight Bow
entries: This bow is hand-carved carefully from the bones of a dryad and stained in the undead blood of vampires. Strung with the hair of a banshee with a powerful wraith animus is placed within the handle. Once the bow's crafting is complete, it fades from its physical form into a semi-corporeal form.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic longbow.
The bow produces its own spectral ammunition which deals Force damage instead of Piercing damage. The ammunition disappears when it hits or misses a target.

While attuned to this weapon, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to see into the Ethereal Plane and see all {@condition invisible} creatures and objects until the end of your turn. Additionally, you can see through all walls and solid objects within 60 feet of you until the end of your turn. During this time, ammunition fired from this bow passes through solid objects, and you can target enemies within 60 feet of you with your ranged attacks, even if they are behind total cover. You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only if you haven't moved during your turn. After you use the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the end of your turn.

item.name: Frozen Armor

entries: This armor channels cold energy through carefully manufactured veins of elemental fluid that run along the inside of its frame. Elemental dust is mixed with the gold in its forming, and contaminated ichor is used as a catalyst to magnify the magical effects. The animus gem placed centrally upon it must be infused with the energy of a frost giant.
While attuned to this armor you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage and are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

This magical armor has six charges, and regains all expended charges each day at dawn. When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 1 charge from the armor to freeze your attacker in place. The creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (DC 15).

entries: A close-fitting shirt of hardened leather with long sleeves.

base.name: Leather Shirt
entries: A lightweight garment of hardened leather, providing some protection to its wearer while allowing for great freedom of movement.

specificVariant.name: Frozen Leather Shirt
entries: A lightweight garment of hardened leather, providing some protection to its wearer while allowing for great freedom of movement.

base.name: Ring-Mail
entries: This armour is leather armour with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armour against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armor.

specificVariant.name: Frozen Ring-Mail
entries: This armour is leather armour with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armour against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armor.

base.name: Scale Armour
entries: This armour consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.

specificVariant.name: Frozen Scale Armour
entries: This armour consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.

base.name: Spiked Armor
entries: Spiked armor is a rare type of medium armor made by dwarves. It consists of a leather coat and leggings covered with spikes that are usually made of metal.

specificVariant.name: Frozen Spiked Armor

item.name: Familiar Figurine
entries: Once per day as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can use this finely-carved figurine to cast {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}.

item.name: Everhot Stew Pot
entries: This cauldron is made using the plated iron from a construct infused with the ash of an elemental. The animus used must be from a dragon which adds both control and potency to the latent elemental magics. The spoon used to stir the cauldron is carved from the bone of a magical creature. This cauldron can heat to boiling temperatures without requiring fire simply by being filled and stirred, and the stews and soups it produces are always delicious and hearty.

During a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can cook enough stew to feed up to three creatures. All creatures who eat a stew from this pot gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While a creature has these {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, they gain {@condition Valor|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 1d4}).

entries: This ring, composed of living lightning, is forged from elemental dust compressed into a gem around the lens eye of a construct, washed in the acidic glands of a monster before being set into an animus of an elemental.

When you cast a spell using a spell slot that deals Lightning damage, choose one target that failed its first saving throw against that spell. That creature is {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Crimson Blade

entries: A blood-red ichor drips down this sword's darkened steel blade. The sword is coated in sanguine witch blood. The dust of dead vampires is forged into the steel of the blade, giving it its blackened sheen. The edge is then empowered by the heart of a dragon. Its gold hilt wrapped in crimson leathers and a bloodred ruby plucked from the corpse of a Sanguine Witch. The fangs of vampires decorate the pommel.
You gain a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic sword.

Any a creature you hit with this weapon that isn't a Construct or Undead takes an extra {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

entries.name: Curse
entries: While attuned to this blade, you can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of its occupants.

entries: This crest is crafted from the compressed dust of fiends destroyed and sanctified by the Sacred Flame and torched in fires ignited by the elemental fluid taken from a dragon. This simple crest is made from the bones of undead creatures washed in acidic monster bile.
While attuned to this magic crest you increase the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of your Aura of Protection by 10 feet.

item.name: Cold Snap Circlet
entries: This icy circlet is made from {@condition frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} contaminated ichor, kept in a state of permafrost by the heart of a naturally cold creature, and lined with {@condition frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} bones of undead, all powered by the animus of an elemental. Even in its permanently {@condition frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} state, it is comfortable to wear.

Once per turn, when you cast a spell that deals Cold damage using a spell slot, you can choose one target that was dealt Cold damage by the spell to gain the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. The escape DC equals your spell save DC.

entries: This steel circlet is forged from a construct and set with a gemstone animus containing a fiend. After being cleansed in the fires of a dragon's breath, this holy circlet glimmers with radiant energy.

item.name: Charm of Swarms
entries: This charm resembles a large gnat. It is made of the spores of dead mushrooms; the mandibles of an insectoid creature are placed upon it. The charm is coated in an acidic bile and held together by dried mucus. It smells of bugs and rot.

When an enemy within 5 feet of you scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on an attack made against you, you can cause the enemy to become {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d6} Necrotic). While the target is {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in this way, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attacks against the target.

item.name: Charged Gauntlets
entries: These light gauntlets are made from cloth woven from the hair of a fiend and reinforced with the scales of a dragon. The gauntlets are washed with an alchemical formula made from elemental fluid and undead dust. They are then powered with a rare animus collected from an aberration.

Each time you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} while attuned to these magic gauntlets they gain one charge. The gauntlets can have up to 10 charges. Any unexpended charges disappear when you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}.
While the gauntlets have at least one charge, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal Lightning damage instead of its normal damage type.

While the gauntlets have 5 or more charges, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal an additional {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage and push the target 10 feet away from you on a hit.
You can expend 2 charges from the gauntlets to cast the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell.
You can expend 10 charges from the gauntlets to cast {@spell Destructive Wave|XPHB} or {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, using your monk's focus saving throw DC.

base.name: Yklwa
entries: A yklwa (pronounced YICK-ul-wah) is a simple melee weapon that is the traditional weapon of Chultan warriors. A yklwa consists of a 3-foot wooden shaft with a steel or stone blade up to 18 inches long. Although it has the thrown weapon property, the yklwa is not well balanced for throwing.

item.name: Bracers of Arc Lightning
entries: These bracers are crafted with fine leathers decorated with magical scales, washed in elemental fluids, elemental dust, and contaminated ichor. The animus used must be from a creature that deals Lightning damage, allowing the bracers to channel the element.
While wearing these magic bracers you gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

These magic bracers have six charges, and regain all expended charges each day at dawn. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can expend one charge from the bracers to deal an extra {@damage 3d6} Lightning damage to the target. A target which takes this damage has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of your next turn.

The metal of this blade is forged in the dust of celestials, with a hilt wrapped in fiend skin leather. The eye of a dragon is placed upon the hilt and polished in monster blood.
